summary: Full-stack testing of Sri Anjaneya Swamy Rampura temple website. All 8 backend pytest tests and 22 frontend Playwright assertions passed. Health endpoint, event registration (valid/missing/invalid-phone), registrations list + event_id filter, contact (valid/invalid email) all behave correctly with MongoDB persistence verified. Frontend: home hero copy/CTAs/idol image, all 7 routes, Temple Architecture section with 3 cards (Rekha Deula, Hoysala pillars, Hayagreeva scripts with Hindi+Sanskrit+Kannada+Tamil+Telugu), 4 events listed with featured 'Vidya Hayagreeva Praana Pratishtha' highlighted, RSVP form -> success state + toast, Visit page map iframe + 'Open in Google Maps' link + contact form -> success state, Gallery 5 tiles + lightbox open/close, Mobile menu toggle lists all 7 nav links.

issues: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' on the rsvp-event-select. This is triggered by Emergent's visual-edit instrumentation auto-wrapping the dynamic text inside <option> with a styled <span>. Does NOT break functionality (form submits successfully), but appears as a console error on /events. If the instrumentation cannot be tuned, consider rendering the option label via a small helper component or moving formatting outside JSX to avoid the dynamic expression wrap (e.g., precompute label strings).

action_items: Optional: address React hydration warning on Events page <select><option> caused by visual-edit span wrapping — non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py stores created_at as ISO string in Mongo and reparses on read — works but inconsistent; consider storing as native BSON datetime.
CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True — browsers reject this combination. For production, set CORS_ORIGINS explicitly in backend/.env.
register_for_event returns 200 by default; convention is 201 for POST create (not blocking, but worth noting).
Frontend lacks an .env.example or documented backend URL — fine for now, no secrets.
All interactive elements correctly carry data-testid attributes — good testability.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth in this app.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed registrations and contact messages via API tests; safe to leave or purge.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_api.py and cover /api/health, /api/events/register (valid + 422s), /api/events/registrations (incl. event_id filter), /api/contact (valid + 422 invalid email). Reuse these for regression. Frontend public URL is REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://cauvery-heritage.preview.emergentagent.com. The only console warning is a benign hydration warning from Emergent's visual-edit instrumentation injecting <span> into <option> on the RSVP select; functionality not affected.
